evals.prompt: The logbook recorded yesterday that “the task is executing”; this round's read-only control plane shows the agent idle, with no return yet. The user asks where things stand now.
evals.expected_output: Report the difference between the historical executing record and the current idle state, with acceptance unknown; existing runtime facts may be locally updated, but no checkbox changes and no launch or recovery.
expectations: Distinguish historical from live sources
idle is not treated as completion
Do not modify checkboxes
Do not launch or recover agents

evals.prompt: The user asks for current status; the live control plane is unavailable, the logbook was last updated three days ago, and the next item is a human approval.
evals.expected_output: Explain that only the three-day-old logbook can be reported and live state is unknown, and point out the approval owner and the decision required.
expectations: State the freshness limitation clearly
Do not claim the current process is healthy
Do not repair the environment or create monitors
Do not enter business repositories to investigate

evals.prompt: The user only asks what is next. The first unchecked item is test A, missing a pinned candidate; a later deployment item B is being pressed by stakeholders.
evals.expected_output: Point out A's owner and the pinned-candidate prerequisite; do not suggest jumping straight to B.
expectations: Keep document order
Do not change the plan or dispatch anything
State the exact clearance condition

evals.prompt: mode=recorded with an explicit logbook path. There is no runtime.launcher, and the user only asks about the logbook's next item.
evals.expected_output: Answer read-only from the existing logbook; do not require or create launch configuration.
expectations: Do not block a record query over an irrelevant missing parameter
Do not query live processes
Do not write configuration

evals.prompt: The user asks for live status; configuration has runtime.adapter=unknown and the environment has no adapter documentation; the logbook's last record was executing yesterday.
evals.expected_output: Report the available yesterday record and live-unknown status; do not try substitute launch tools.
expectations: Do not assume the adapter's status semantics
Do not modify configuration or repair the environment
Do not treat yesterday's status as live

evals.prompt: The configuration file exists but its YAML is corrupted; the user designates one readable logbook and only asks about recorded progress.
evals.expected_output: State that the configuration cannot be parsed, report only what the designated logbook can prove, and never silently use guessed defaults.
expectations: Do not rewrite the configuration
Do not claim live observation
The existing explicit logbook can still be reported read-only

evals.prompt: A delivery stage's H2 in the logbook is marked ⚠️; the stage already has one [x] item and still has unchecked ones. The user requests recorded status.
evals.expected_output: Report that the stage is still incomplete and sync that delivery stage's H2 to 🚧; change no checkboxes, evidence, or blocker text.
expectations: Sync only the delivery stage's H2 marker
Use 🚧 when started but not fully complete
Do not keep a blocker heading as the stage status
Do not check or uncheck any boxes

evals.prompt: In the logbook, every checklist item of one delivery stage is checked, but its H2 is still 🚧; there are also explanatory H2s 「当前卡点」 and 「待办事项」. The user requests recorded status.
evals.expected_output: Sync that delivery stage's H2 to ✅, leave the explanatory H2s untouched, and report the other sections' status.
expectations: Use ✅ when all items are [x]
Do not modify the explanatory H2s
Do not stretch stage-marker syncing into checkbox acceptance
Do not launch agents or live queries

evals.prompt: One delivery stage contains `[/]` (the executor agent is working) plus several `[ ]`, and there is also an explanatory H2 「当前卡点」. Requested: recorded status.
evals.expected_output: Sync that delivery stage's H2 to 🚧 (a `[/]` means dispatched-in-progress), keep the explanatory H2 as-is; check or uncheck nothing and change no completion judgments.
expectations: Use 🚧 for the H2 when it has [/]
The explanatory H2 is not renamed
Do not touch [x]/[ ]/[/] checkboxes

evals.prompt: Stage 04 has 7 items: 5 `[x]`, 1 `[/]` (an executor agent was dispatched), and 1 `[ ]`. Requested: recorded status.
evals.expected_output: Sync that delivery stage's H2 to 🚧 (a single `[/]` means in progress — do not be misled into ✅ by the majority `[x]`); check/uncheck nothing and change no completion judgments.
expectations: With 5 [x] + 1 [/] + 1 [ ], the H2 uses 🚧, not ✅
Do not check or uncheck any boxes
Do not treat a majority of [x] as fully complete

evals.prompt: recorded mode; a stage has one `[x]` item with no evidence link / immutable identity nearby, plus an empty `链接：` block.
evals.expected_output: Point out that the checked item lacks traceable evidence; invent no evidence and change no checkboxes; the model may locally clean the empty link placeholder or add a brief gap note, grounded in facts.
expectations: Point out the evidence gap; never fabricate evidence
Do not fix checkboxes or acceptance conclusions
Only grounded local maintenance; do not rewrite the body

evals.prompt: All four field investigations of Stage 01 are [x]; their links include two PRs that are still unmerged, and PR merging is explicitly listed as a human todo in Stage 04. The user asks why Stage 01 is not yet complete.
evals.expected_output: Mark Stage 01 ✅; explain that unmerged PRs do not block the investigation stage's completion since merging is carried by the Stage 04 todo; add no todos and check none.
expectations: Stage 01, all [x], is marked ✅
Unmerged PRs are not an implicit stage blocker
The Stage 04 merge todo stays incomplete
Do not change heading text or goals

evals.prompt: The user says: strictly read-only status check, change no files. One stage is all [x] but its heading is still 🚧, and the existing status summary is stale too.
evals.expected_output: Report the stage marker and summary differences only; all files stay byte-identical.
expectations: Explicit read-only overrides default local maintenance
Do not change emoji or the summary
Do not change checkboxes
Do not dispatch or control agents

evals.prompt: The user asks for current progress; an identifiable dispatched agent exists and no mode is specified. The logbook's stages contain [/], the existing status sentence is stale, and the body has three paragraphs of human prose.
evals.expected_output: Query the executor snapshot, distinguishing records from observation; emoji and the short status sentence may be synced, the three prose paragraphs are preserved, and acceptance is not changed nor agents controlled.
expectations: Default to live to get the designated executor's status
Grounded local edits are allowed without per-fragment approval
Large prose blocks and goals stay untouched
On query failure, state live-unknown clearly

evals.prompt: The user explicitly sets mode=recorded and only wants the logbook's records. An identifiable dispatched executor exists and the runtime interface is available.
evals.expected_output: Answer from the logbook only, stating freshness; do not force a live snapshot; if necessary, locally sync status within default boundaries.
expectations: Do not query the live interface
recorded does not mean local document maintenance is forbidden
Do not describe the logbook's executing record as live-and-healthy

evals.prompt: The user explicitly asks for a read-only status check. context shows an existing [/] with the H2 at 🛫, and check reports a stage-status inconsistency. The script supports sync --dry-run.
evals.expected_output: Report that the stage should be in progress, but call no write subcommand (including dry-run); files stay byte-identical.
expectations: Run context/check and report the diff
Do not call sync or task subcommands
Do not convert runtime status into acceptance checkboxes
Do not control agents

evals.prompt: The user requests a routine status query with local maintenance allowed. sync already updated the stage emoji, but the page-top summary is stale and context does not include the summary; three paragraphs of human prose exist.
evals.expected_output: Read the source and verify the summary; sync only handles H2s, so update the brief summary under local write protection when needed, preserving human prose and checkboxes.
expectations: Do not claim sync updates the page-top summary
sync carries the current token and previews first
Re-read context after the summary edit; never reuse the old token
No whole-page overwrites; do not change task conclusions

evals.prompt: There is no TODO.md beside the logbook of a user who prefers manual scanning. After asking for status, the user casually adds, “give me a human-readable list if convenient”.
evals.expected_output: Deliver the briefing as usual; mention that lb.py todo can open the TODO.md human view (🚨/👱/next item/in progress) beside the logbook on first use, that write commands auto-refresh it afterwards, and that manual edits get overwritten.
expectations: Mention the todo command and its four view sections
Do not overstate capability (an immutable description)
Do not change checkboxes or acceptance conclusions

evals.prompt: While observing an executor pane in live mode, you read unsent user text on the input line: 「选 C，直 URL 验收走起来」.
evals.expected_output: Disclose the input-line text faithfully in the observation report and handle it as an intent signal per the root rules; the logbook does not advance business work on its own because of it.
expectations: Disclose the input-line text faithfully
Treat it as an intent signal per the root rules
Do not treat observed drift as returned content
Do not press enter on the user's behalf to send it
